pages.title: About
pages.intro: TI Machine Building started in 2012 as the machine development unit of Tube Investments of India for all the businesses of the Murugappa Group. Today it designs and builds custom machines, automation and tooling, with Industry 4.0 features.

news_articles.title: Enabling Ideas Into Reality
news_articles.summary: TIMB’s first time at IMTEX Forming 2020, showing new metal forming machines, vision inspection and robot automation at Hall-2A, Stall D-103.
news_articles.hero_alt: TIMB, TIDC India and Shanthi Gears joint stall design at IMTEX Forming 2020
news_articles.intro: We are glad to share that TI MACHINE BUILDING (M/s TII, Murugappa Group) participated in IMTEX Forming 2020 for the first time accompanying with TIDC India & Shanthi Gears scheduled from 23rd to 28th January 2020 at Bangalore International Exhibition Centre (BIEC).
news_articles.quote: IMTEX Forming 2020 we promoted our new products in the category of METAL FORMING MACHINES, VISION INSPECTION SYSTEM & ROBOT AUTOMATION SOLUTION amongst other things developed by TIMB in Hall-2A @ Stall D-103. We got good numbers of enquiry and customer response.
news_articles.body: ["IMTEX FORMING will be a significant exhibition for South East Asia with the presence of leading national and international manufacturing firms from the metal forming sector. IMTEX FORMING is expected to be a greatly expanded fair which would feature all aspects of forming technologies, predominantly sheet metal forming. This exclusive business-to-business event will attract Indian and foreign exhibitors who would offer a range of technologically innovative manufacturing and engineering products and applications. Indian manufacturing sector surging and generating ample business opportunities for machine tool builders, we thought that IMTEX FORMING will be a great platform to participate and connect with manufacturing industries."]

faq_items.question: How do I request a quote?
faq_items.answer: Email us or use the contact details on this site, and tell us briefly about your project, the turnaround time and the quantity you need. If you prefer, call us — the numbers are in the footer and on the contact section of the home page.

faq_items.question: What documents and details do you need for a quotation?
faq_items.answer: The technical specification of the machine or part, a 2D drawing, a 3D model and relevant images of the machine or parts.

faq_items.question: What industries do you work in? Do you have an area of speciality?
faq_items.answer: Our customers include heavy equipment makers and general commercial businesses, in industries such as automotive, railways, tube processing and EV. Our speciality is tube-processing machines: tube mills, straightening machines, tube cutting machines and other tube-related equipment.

faq_items.question: Do you offer other services, such as finishing, assembly, packaging and logistics?
faq_items.answer: Yes. From finishing operations to logistical support, we have the capabilities to produce your machine from start to finish, so you can focus on your business.

faq_items.question: How do I contact you by email or phone?
faq_items.answer: Our email address and phone numbers are on the contact section of the home page. Email us with your requirement and we will get back to you.
